messages.text:
I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key movement between cards. Focus stops at board edges, remembers the selected card, and leaves modified keys to the browser.

Verification passed: 138 unit tests and 76 browser tests, including the complete keyboard game and accessibility journey.
